title: Why your Effect runs twice in development

slides.say: In development, your Effect’s log shows up twice. That’s not a bug in React. It’s on purpose.

slides.text: Strict Mode remounts every component once, right after the first mount. Development only.
slides.say: With Strict Mode, React mounts each component, removes it, and mounts it again. Only in development.

slides.text: With a good cleanup you see: connect, disconnect, connect.
slides.say: If your cleanup is right, you’ll see connect, disconnect, connect. One live connection at the end. No harm done.

slides.text: Without cleanup: two open connections. The remount exposed a real bug.
slides.say: Without cleanup, you end up with two connections. That would also happen when users move around your app. The remount just shows it early.

slides.text: Don’t ask “how do I run it once?” Ask “does it work after remounting?”
slides.say: So don’t try to make it run once. Make setup, cleanup, setup look the same to the user as a single setup.
